title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalamu Alikum, I have taken loan (Interest free) from 2 relatives Rs 15000 & Rs 10000 while going to Hajj. Inshallah I am planning to repay Rs 15000 next month, Inshallah I will be having even extra Rs 10000 next month, but I am planning to pay Rs 10000 next to next month Inshallah (i.e., August) as I am now in Kolkata, whereas I am from Tamil Nadu, I am thinking to keep this 10000, keeping in mind for some emergency, say to go to Tamil Nadu etc. Both of the relatives are not asking for money. Do let me know what should I need to do in this situation, do I have to pay that Rs 10000 next month itself or I can pay next to next month, where I will be having Inshallah another Rs 10000 extra after getting my Salary. Do let me know can we keep some amount for emergencies, is it permissible in Islam. Please let me know as soon as possible. 1841 views Q. I have a question I was hoping you could help me find the answer to inshallah. A friend of mine is studying to be a vet and on completion of their studies they will inshallah work at a vetinary hospital for animals. One of the concerns they have is that on occasions they will have to put down animals for various reasons. The reasons can vary such as the owner of the animal is unable to afford the cost of the operation, the animal is in great pain and so on. In islam is it permissable to put animals down taking into the above reasons and any others you can think of. 1955 views Q. Assalamu Alaykum W.W. I work in restaurent where we sell pork meat along with other meats and vegetables.So is it Islamically good to work there? And is it good to own such type of restaurent? 2025 views Q. I am from Rawalpindi, i need confirmation about Prize Bond ( In Pakistan ), Is Prize Bond halal or not, Please guide me about this (with explanation) Thanks! 16497 views Q. Is Fashion Designing Course permissible for girls? 2524 views Q. Can a Muslim be appointed as the power of attorney over a family will who is non-Muslim 2138 views Q. Assalamu Alaicum Warahmatullah 1- Is it permissible for a Muslim adviser to review and correct a contract made between his client (Muslim) and the bank (Aqd ijaarah). Will it be permissible for this adviser to take a fee for the corrections made in favour of the client? 2- Is the income of a Bank Haraam? is it permissible to sell a car or shop to a Bank? 1357 views Q. Business with Banks 2852 views Q. As per my company's policy,I can claim Rs 200/- without any bill while going back home at night. But, I come to office by auto in the afternoon for Rs 30/- and I go back home by Cab fo Rs 10/-. I claim Rs 40/-(30 10) per day for transport fare. Please let me know whether is it permissible or not. 1744 views Q. Is it permitted to do Internet Cafe business for Muslims? 2557 views Q. I want to ask a question in the light of quran & shariyat, if we are stealing electricity I mean we are preaparing food on stolen electricity or we are getting income from stolen electricity ( I mean our works are running on stolen electricity) so this food and income is halal or not. And also if the electricity officer come to our house for inspection and we check them & beat them then it is permissible in the Islam, So sir please clear. 3997 views Q. Taking house on rent by paying advance amount 4064 views Q. Use of Haram Money 10393 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. Providing services to SIKH Yatries 2230 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 150920 Country: India Title: My job's salary is halal or not Question: I do the job in Paytm. My department is oil and gas department. In my job profile I contact the petrol pump owner to provide him Paytm facility. Paytm is a mobile app. It is a mobile wallet and through the Paytm you can do the shopping. I take the pump document for create their account in Paytm. If anybody pays the bill of petrol or diesel through Paytm, our company hold their pump payment for 24 hour under Paytm and take the interest through RBI and after 24 hour my company send the payment into the pump's owner bank account. My company distribute the salary by that money which he take from RBI as a interest. So please tell me that my salary is Haram or not? Answer ID: 150920 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 866/864/B=9/1438) When Paytm takes interest from RBI and you get your salary from that interest money then how this salary could be halal for you. You should search any other lawful job and when you get one then leave this present job. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
